subject: Transportation Systems
title: Shared Micromobility
description: A quick win: understand Shared Micromobility.

hook.text: E-scooters scattered across sidewalks looked like chaos. But the data says they're replacing car trips.

buildup.text: Shared bikes and scooters fill the gap between transit stops and final destinations—the last-mile problem.

discovery.text: Studies show 30 to 40 percent of scooter trips replace car rides. Emissions drop when cars stay parked.

twist.text: Sidewalk clutter, rider injuries, and vandalism caused backlash. Many cities banned or heavily regulated them.

climax.text: Cities that created proper parking corrals and speed zones kept micromobility working. Rules, not bans, are the answer.

punchline.text: Scooters solve the last mile—if cities manage the mess.
